q: I hang on the wall and tick all day, telling you when it's time for bed. What am I?
I open up like a flower when it rains, and keep you dry as you walk. What am I?
I show you your own face, but I never talk back. What am I?
The more I work, the shorter I get, and I leave a gray trail wherever I write. What am I?
I have two blades and two holes for your fingers, and I open and close to cut paper. What am I?
I'm small and metal, and I can open a locked door, but I can't open a book. What am I?
I have rungs like a staircase, but I lean against a wall instead of standing on my own. What am I?
I have bristles like a brush, a long handle, and I sweep the dust off the floor. What am I?
I have a wick and I melt as I burn, giving off a warm glow at night. What am I?
I'm full of air, come in bright colors, and I can pop with a loud bang. What am I?
I fly high in the sky at the end of a string, and I need the wind to lift me up. What am I?
I have many pages full of words and pictures, and you turn my pages to read a story. What am I?
I have four legs but I cannot walk, and I love it when you sit on my back. What am I?
I have a soft mattress and pillows, and you crawl into me every night to sleep. What am I?
I'm made of glass, let the sunlight in, and you can look through me to see outside. What am I?
I have a handle and hinges, and I open and close to let you in or out. What am I?
I come in pairs, protect your feet, and I have laces to tie. What am I?
I have five little pockets for your fingers, and I keep your hands warm. What am I?
I have many teeth but I never bite, and I run through your hair to make it neat. What am I?
I have soft bristles on one end, and you use me twice a day to keep your teeth clean. What am I?
I make bubbles when you rub me with water, and I wash the dirt right off your hands. What am I?
I'm full of tiny holes, I soak up water like a thirsty little creature, and I help clean the dishes. What am I?
I have a handle on top, and you can fill me with water or sand to carry it around. What am I?
I don't have a voice of my own, but I ring out loud whenever someone shakes me. What am I?
I have a tight skin stretched over a hollow body, and I make a loud boom when you hit me. What am I?
I have strings stretched across my body, and you pluck me to make music. What am I?
I have black and white keys in a row, and pressing me makes musical notes. What am I?
I have a lens like an eye, and I capture a moment forever in a picture. What am I?
I ring to get your attention, and I let you talk to someone far away. What am I?
I have a door that keeps my inside cold, and I keep your food fresh so it doesn't spoil. What am I?
I get very hot inside, and I bake your cookies and cakes until they're golden. What am I?
I have spinning blades, and I don't make air cold, but I move it around to cool you off. What am I?
I have a bulb inside, and I light up a room when you flip my switch. What am I?
I'm small and store power inside me, but I run out of energy after a while. What am I?
I can't see, hear, or move on my own, but I pull certain metal objects toward me. What am I?
I show you roads, rivers, and cities, but I'm flat and much smaller than the real world. What am I?
I always point the same direction no matter which way you turn me, helping you find north. What am I?
I have numbers on my side, and I tell you how hot or cold something is. What am I?
I'm made of many pages, one for each month, and I show you every day of the year. What am I?
I'm made of paper, and I keep a letter safe inside me until it reaches the mailbox. What am I?
I'm small and sticky, and you put me in the corner of an envelope before mailing it. What am I?
I have two rows of little teeth, and you pull my tab to open or close a jacket. What am I?
I'm small and round, and you push me through a little hole to close a shirt. What am I?
I'm thin and sharp with a tiny hole near my tip, and thread passes through me to sew. What am I?
I'm one small part of a bigger picture, and I only fit in one special spot. What am I?
I have straps that go over your shoulders, and I carry your books to school. What am I?
I sit on your wrist, have a small face and hands, and tell you the time wherever you go. What am I?
I have straight edges marked with numbers, and I help you draw a perfectly straight line. What am I?
I make a loud, sharp sound when you blow into me, and coaches use me to start a game. What am I?
I have slots on top, and I turn plain bread into warm, crispy toast. What am I?
